_doc: Pearl's Secret Bases: the choices, not Pearl's data (that comes from the dump: b2tools/secret_base_data.py). notes/SECRET_BASES.md, notes/DECISIONS.md.
_flags_from_hideaways: Link play is cut, so nobody's Flag can be captured: each new visit to a Hideaway brings one Flag (registered at the PC by Pearl's lines), so the ranks and their limits (goods, removable Big Boulders) still rise. false: the Flag stays Normal for good (10 goods, no boulder can go), as a Pearl played alone.
_trader_price_per_size: The goods traders take money while digging isn't built: the middle of the good's Sphere sizes x this. Yellow Cushion (8-10) $900, Pikachu Doll (70-99) $8,500.
